description: Looks up a US employer by name in the US Labor Department's certified green card (PERM) and H-1B applications for healthcare jobs: how many it had certified, for which jobs, the hourly wage it offered and where. Use it when someone asks whether an employer sponsors visas or has a job offer from one. A record shows the employer has sponsored that kind of job, not that a particular offer is genuine.

employer.description: The employer's name as the job offer or posting gives it, e.g. 'Presbyterian Healthcare Services'.

name: check_employer_visa_record
title: US employer visa sponsorship record
